segments.text: اور کبھی کبھی آپ کو لگتا ہے کہ ان کے reaction slow یا غلط ہے تو irritation پھر سے بڑھ جاتی ہے.
segments.translated: And sometimes you feel that their reaction is slow or wrong, which increases the irritation again.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Exactly.
segments.translated: Exactly.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: کبھی کبھی disgust بھی feel ہوتا ہے کہ لوگ سمجھ نہیں پا رہے ہیں.
segments.translated: Sometimes I also feel disgusted that people are not understanding.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: Interesting.
segments.translated: Interesting.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: اور جب آپ خود کے behavior observe کرتے ہیں کیسا feel ہوتا ہے؟
segments.translated: And how do you feel when you observe your own behavior?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: کبھی satisfaction، کبھی guilty بھی کہ شاید overreact کر گیا.
segments.translated: Sometimes satisfaction, and sometimes guilt, that maybe I overreacted.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: یہ awareness important ہے کیونکہ پہلا step self regulation کا یہی ہے.
segments.translated: This awareness is important because the first step in self-regulation is exactly this.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: ہاں اور honestly مجھے لگتا ہے کہ میں زیادہ aware ہوں ان سے اور {PHYSICAL_ATTRIBUTE_1} بھی ہوں.
segments.translated: Yes, and honestly I feel that I am more aware than they are and also {PHYSICAL_ATTRIBUTE_1}.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: اور جب آپ smarter feel کرتے ہیں، کبھی کبھی superior یا proud بھی محسوس کرتے ہیں.
segments.translated: And when you feel smarter, do you sometimes also feel superior or proud?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: ہاں اور کبھی arrogance بھی آ جاتا ہے unintentionally.
segments.translated: Yes, and sometimes arrogance comes up unintentionally.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: تو next step یہ ہوگا کہ ہم strategy design کریں جو anger اور self focus کو manage کر سکے.
segments.translated: So the next step will be for us to design a strategy that can manage anger and self-focus.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Sounds good.
segments.translated: Sounds good.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: مجھے لگتا ہے کہ میں تھوڑا اور کا-کام improve try کر سکتا ہوں.
segments.translated: I feel like I can try to improve a little more on that.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: اور ہم practice کریں گے کہ کسی validate کرنا-- کیسے validate کرنا اور assert کرنا balance میں ہو.
segments.translated: And we will practice how to validate someone and assert yourself in a balanced way.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: ہاں اور کبھی کبھی لوگوں کو reaction سے بھی humor feel ہوتا ہے.
segments.translated: Yes, and sometimes people also find humor in the reaction.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: ایک طرح کا satisfaction.
segments.translated: A kind of satisfaction.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: Excellent.
segments.translated: Excellent.

segments.speaker: THERAPIST
segments.text: یہ awareness آپ کو situation handle کرنے میں help کرے گی.
segments.translated: This awareness will help you handle the situation.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: شکریہ। آج session کے بعد لگتا ہے کہ anger تھوڑا manageable لگ رہا ہے.
segments.translated: Thank you. After today's session, it feels like the anger is a little more manageable.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: خدا حافظ.
segments.translated: Goodbye.
